mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_course_views (course_id, viewer_key, view_date, user_id, viewed_at) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{viewerKey}, #{viewDate}, #{userId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{at}) ON CONFLICT (course_id, viewer_key, view_date) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO tb_view_salts (view_date, salt) VALUES (#{date}, #{salt}) ON CONFLICT (view_date) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT salt FROM tb_view_salts WHERE view_date = #{date}
